column3: The Hebrew names flaming fire; BSB identifies lightning.
The Hebrew has a singular vine and fig tree; BSB uses plurals.
The Hebrew has a singular eating verb and singular fruit; BSB has plural they and produce.
The Hebrew says He brought them out without naming Israel; BSB explicitly names Israel.
The Hebrew names their dread without naming Israel; BSB specifies dread of Israel.
The Hebrew has a singular asking verb; BSB says they asked.
The Hebrew says waters went as a river, without an explicit like; BSB supplies like.
The Hebrew names Abraham separately without an explicit to; BSB describes a promise to Abraham.
The Hebrew names the labor of peoples as the inheritance; BSB supplies the fruit of others’ labor.
